title: ASAD: Adaptive Software Agents for Debugging
title_zh: ASAD：用于调试的自适应软件代理

paragraphs.en: The integration of Large Language Models (LLMs) into multi-agent systems has shown great potential for automated debugging. Yet nearly all current frameworks rely on rigid, predefined architectures: the number of agents, their roles, and their interaction patterns are fixed before any analysis of the bug occurs. This one-size-fits-all approach is fundamentally mismatched to the heterogeneous nature of software defects. Simple bugs waste resources on unnecessary coordination, while complex ones suffer from insufficient or poorly aligned expertise.
paragraphs.zh: 将大型语言模型（LLM）整合到多智能体系统中，在自动化调试方面展现出巨大潜力。 然而，几乎所有现有框架都依赖僵化的预定义架构：在分析任何错误之前，智能体的数量、其角色以及互动模式都已被固定。 这种“一刀切”的方法与软件缺陷的异构特性从根本上不匹配。 简单的错误会浪费资源进行不必要的协调，而复杂的错误则因专业知识不足或未能有效协同而难以解决。

paragraphs.en: This paper introduces ASAD, an adaptive agentic system for debugging that configures its team according to the nature and complexity of each bug. ASAD initiates the debugging process by analyzing the faulty code and dynamically determines the number of agents to deploy, the specialized roles they should have, and the collaboration strategy they should follow. A central coordinator orchestrates this process through iterative planning, reflection, and execution; applying fast single-pass repairs for simple issues while assembling purpose-built teams to tackle more complex failures. We evaluate ASAD on three established benchmarks: Defects4J, DebugBench, and CodeFlaws, using multiple LLMs, such as DeepSeek-V3, Qwen-3 and GPT-5. ASAD consistently improves bug-fix rates by 12–20% over chain-of-thought(CoT) prompting and consistently outperforms static multi-agent systems by 4–9% in fix precision while reducing average agent usage by 32%. Crucially, our system dynamically adjusts the number and roles of agents: it resolves simple bugs with minimal coordination and scales agent involvement only for more complex cases.
paragraphs.zh: 本文介绍了 ASAD，一个用于调试的自适应智能体系统，它会根据每个错误的性质和复杂性来配置其团队。 ASAD 通过分析有缺陷的代码来启动调试过程，并动态确定需要部署的智能体数量、它们应具备的专业角色以及应遵循的合作策略。 一个中央协调器通过迭代规划、反思和执行来组织这一过程：对于简单问题，采用快速的单次修复；而对于更复杂的故障，则组建专门定制的团队进行应对。 我们在三个成熟的基准数据集上对 ASAD 进行了评估：Defects4J、DebugBench 和 CodeFlaws，并使用了多款大型语言模型（LLM），例如 DeepSeek-V3、Qwen-3 和 GPT-5。 与思维链（CoT）提示方法相比，ASAD 的 bug 修复率稳定提升了 12%–20%；在修复准确性方面，它也比静态多智能体系统稳定高出 4%–9%，同时平均智能体使用量减少了 32%。 关键在于，我们的系统能够动态调整智能体的数量与角色：对于简单错误，只需最小程度的协调即可解决；而对于更复杂的案例，才会相应增加智能体的参与。

paragraphs.en: Large Language Models (LLMs) have fundamentally reshaped software engineering research and practice. Their capacity to interpret natural language, reason over code semantics, and generate structured outputs has driven significant advances in code generation [ 1 ] , automated bug repair [ 2 ] , and test synthesis [ 3 ] . These capabilities are further enhanced by reasoning strategies, such as task decomposition, self-reflection, and iterative refinement, that enable LLMs to tackle increasingly complex tasks [ 4 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）从根本上重塑了软件工程的研究与实践。 它们能够理解自然语言、推理代码语义并生成结构化输出的能力，推动了代码生成 [ 1 ]、自动化错误修复 [ 2 ] 和测试合成 [ 3 ] 等领域的重大进展。 通过任务分解、自我反思和迭代优化等推理策略，这些能力得到了进一步增强，使 LLM 能够应对日益复杂的任务 [ 4 ]。

paragraphs.en: A growing body of work explores multi-agent systems, where multiple LLM-powered agents collaborate with specialized roles to solve software engineering problems [ 5 ] . In debugging, for instance, distinct agents may handle fault localization, patch synthesis, static analysis, and validation [ 6 ] . This division of responsibilities mimics human software teams, where collaboration and specialization lead to better results. Such architectures have been shown to improve reasoning quality, reduce hallucinations, and increase success rates in program repair [ 7 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 越来越多的研究开始探索多智能体系统，其中多个由大型语言模型驱动的智能体通过承担不同专业角色进行协作，以解决软件工程问题 [ 5 ] 。 例如，在调试过程中，不同的智能体可以分别负责故障定位、补丁生成、静态分析和验证 [ 6 ] 。 这种职责分工模仿了人类的软件团队模式，其中协作与专业化能够带来更出色的成果。 研究表明，此类架构能够提升推理质量、减少幻觉，并提高程序修复的成功率 [ 7 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Despite this promise, current multi-agent debugging systems suffer from a critical design flaw. Most existing approaches rely on static and rigid architectures in which the number of agents, their roles, and their communication patterns are predefined and remain unchanged throughout execution. [ 8 ] . This lack of adaptability limits the scalability, the same configuration of agents is applied regardless of the complexity of problems, leading to inefficient use of computational resources and avoidable costs in time and computation, particularly for cases that could be effectively handled by a single agent, or suffering from insufficient or misaligned expertise for complex tasks [ 5 ] . Moreover, prolonged interactions among agents often reduce coherence, causing goal drift, where agents gradually move away from the original goals and lose alignment with each other over time [ 9 ] . Existing frameworks also often lack mechanisms for effective context propagation, meaning that agent behavior is not sufficiently conditioned on evolving task state or shared memory. This limitation undermines coordination and shared understanding across agents in complex multi‑agent workflows [ 10 ] . As a consequence, these systems face a trade-off between accuracy and efficiency, constraining their scalability and practical deployment in real-world software engineering tasks [ 5 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 尽管有这一承诺，当前的多智能体调试系统仍存在一个关键的设计缺陷。 大多数现有方法都依赖静态且僵化的架构，其中智能体的数量、角色和通信模式都是预先定义的，并且在整个执行过程中保持不变。[ 8 ] . 这种缺乏适应能力限制了系统的可扩展性：无论问题复杂程度如何，都会采用相同的智能体配置，导致计算资源使用效率低下，并产生本可避免的时间和计算成本，尤其是在那些本可由单个智能体有效处理，或因缺乏足够或匹配的专业能力而无法应对复杂任务的情况下。[ 5 ] . 此外，智能体之间长时间的交互往往会降低一致性，引发目标漂移——即智能体逐渐偏离原始目标，并随着时间的推移失去彼此之间的协调一致。[ 9 ] . 现有框架通常也缺乏有效的上下文传播机制，这意味着智能体的行为并未充分依据不断变化的任务状态或共享记忆进行调整。 这一局限性削弱了复杂多智能体工作流程中智能体之间的协作与共同理解。[ 10 ] . 因此，这些系统必须在准确性与效率之间做出权衡，从而限制了它们在真实世界软件工程任务中的可扩展性和实际部署能力。[ 5 ] .

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we propose ASAD, an adaptive agentic system for debugging that dynamically constructs its team based on the nature and complexity of the faulty code. Rather than relying on a fixed configuration, ASAD begins with an analysis phase in which a central coordinator (the main agent) evaluates the problem’s characteristics and complexity. For simple bugs, it applies a fast, single-pass repair, while for more complex issues, it assembles a tailored team of specialized agents, assigns roles, and orchestrates their collaboration. ASAD integrates three complementary reasoning mechanisms: planning, where the coordinator decomposes debugging into structured subtasks [ 11 ] ; iterative reflection, where agents refine patches based on validation feedback [ 12 ] ; and multi-agent collaboration, where agents interact and share information to jointly solve complex debugging tasks [ 13 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们提出了 ASAD——一个用于调试的自适应智能体系统，它会根据故障代码的性质和复杂程度动态构建团队。 ASAD 不依赖固定配置，而是首先进入分析阶段，由中央协调者（主智能体）评估问题的特征和复杂程度。 对于简单的错误，它会采用快速的一次性修复；而对于更复杂的问题，则会组建一支量身定制的专用智能体团队，分配角色并协调它们的协作。 ASAD 整合了三种互补的推理机制：规划（协调者将调试过程分解为结构化的子任务 [ 11 ]）、迭代反思（智能体根据验证反馈优化修复方案 [ 12 ]）以及多智能体协作（智能体之间互动并共享信息，共同解决复杂的调试任务 [ 13 ]）。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate ASAD on three established benchmarks: DebugBench [ 14 ] , Defects4J [ 15 ] , and CodeFlaws [ 16 ] , using six large language models: Llama-3 [ 17 ] , DeepSeek-V3 [ 18 ] , Mistral [ 19 ] , Qwen-3 [ 20 ] , GPT-5 [ 21 ] and Gemini-1.5 [ 22 ] . The results show that our adaptive system improves bug-fix rates by 12–20% over chain-of-thought prompting and consistently outperforms static multi-agent systems by 4–9% in fix precision while reducing average agent usage by 32%. Crucially, our system deploys a single agent for 73% of syntax and logic errors, and scales up to 4 specialized agents for complex bugs such as concurrency bugs and API misuse patterns. This dynamic scaling delivers higher accuracy without inflating costs, demonstrating that adaptivity, not agent count, is the primary determinant of debugging success.

paragraphs.en: This paper extends our previous work [ 23 ] published in the Ideas, Visions and Reflections track of the 33rd ACM International Conference on the Foundations of Software Engineering 2025. The conference paper introduced the concept of adaptive multi-agent orchestration for code debugging and focused on the core idea and initial feasibility. In this work, we enhance the system, expand the evaluation to multiple benchmarks and LLM families, and provide a deeper analysis of system behavior and practical implications. This extension significantly broaden the scope and empirical evidence beyond the original study, demonstrating the effectiveness and robustness of adaptive agent orchestration in automated program repair.

paragraphs.en: Advances in LLMs have opened up new possibilities in automating software engineering tasks. However, these tasks often require more than language modeling; they require structured reasoning, planning, decision-making, and adaptive behavior. Traditional prompting methods allow LLMs to produce immediate answers, but they struggle with tasks that involve uncertainty, long-term dependencies, or multi-step problem solving. To overcome these limitations, researchers have introduced techniques that enable LLMs to reason deliberately, engage in self-evaluation, utilize tools, and collaborate in specialized roles. These techniques reflect a fundamental shift in the design of LLM-based systems: from static, single-shot generators toward goal-oriented, context-aware, and adaptive agents. This section provides foundational concepts for understanding this transition, focusing first on reasoning mechanisms that enhance LLM problem-solving, and then on the broader notion of agenticness, which frames LLMs as autonomous agents operating in complex environments.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型（LLM）的进步为软件工程的自动化任务开辟了新的可能性。 然而，这些任务通常需要超越语言建模的能力；它们还需要结构化推理、规划、决策和自适应行为。 传统的提示方法能让 LLM 直接生成答案，但在涉及不确定性、长期依赖关系或多步骤问题求解的任务中却显得力不从心。 为了克服这些局限性，研究人员引入了一系列技术，使 LLM 能够进行审慎推理、自我评估、使用工具以及在特定角色中协作。 这些技术反映了基于 LLM 的系统设计发生的一项根本性转变：从静态的单次生成器，转向以目标为导向、具备上下文感知能力和自适应能力的智能体。 本节将介绍理解这一转变的基础概念，首先聚焦于增强 LLM 问题求解能力的推理机制，然后探讨更广泛的“智能体特性”概念，该概念将 LLM 视为在复杂环境中运行的自主智能体。

paragraphs.en: The following paragraphs introduce the key reasoning techniques: Chain-of-Thought for explicit reasoning, Self-Consistency for improved reliability, Iterative Reflection for self-improvement, Planning for strategic decision-making, Tool Use for grounding in external information, and Multi-Agent collaboration for distributed problem solving.

paragraphs.en: The most widely used technique is Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting [ 24 ] . Instead of asking an LLM to output a final answer immediately, CoT prompts the model to articulate its reasoning process explicitly. For example, rather than saying “Fix this bug,” the model is instructed to reason step by step: “First, identify the error type. Next, trace variable values. Then, evaluate possible fixes.” This forces the model to break down complex tasks into manageable subproblems, improving accuracy and making its reasoning traceable.
paragraphs.zh: 最广泛使用的技术是思维链（Chain-of-Thought，CoT）提示法 [ 24 ] 。 CoT 提示法不会直接要求大型语言模型立即输出最终答案，而是引导模型明确阐述其推理过程。 例如，与其直接说“修复这个错误”，不如指导模型逐步推理：“首先，确定错误的类型。 接下来，追踪变量的值。 然后，评估可能的修复方案。”这种方式迫使模型将复杂任务分解为可处理的子问题，从而提高准确性并使推理过程更具可追溯性。

paragraphs.en: To improve consistency and reduce hallucinations, Self-Consistency generates multiple reasoning paths for the same input and selects the most common or best-supported conclusion [ 25 ] . Rather than relying on a single response, the system produces several candidate solutions, compares them for agreement, and chooses the one that aligns with the majority or satisfies predefined constraints, such as passing all test cases. This simple mechanism significantly increases reliability without requiring additional training data.

paragraphs.en: Even with structured reasoning, initial outputs may still contain subtle errors. Iterative Reflection addresses this by allowing the LLM to evaluate and refine its own work [ 12 ] . The model first generates a draft solution, then critically assesses it for correctness, efficiency, and completeness. Based on this self-evaluation, it revises the output. This cycle can repeat multiple times, mimicking the practice of human developers who review and improve their code before submission. External feedback from another LLM acting as a critic can further enhance quality by identifying logical inconsistencies or style issues.

paragraphs.en: For more complex tasks, Planning enables the LLM to design a sequence of actions before execution. Rather than jumping to a solution, the model formulates a strategy: “To fix this bug, I must first locate the faulty function, analyze its inputs and outputs, generate candidate fixes, test each one, and validate against the full test suite.” Huang et al. [ 11 ] identify five key planning strategies: (1) Task decomposition: splitting a problem into smaller, manageable subtasks; (2) Multi-plan selection: generating multiple candidate plans and choosing the most promising one; (3) External module-aided planning: integrating external tools, such as static analyzers or symbolic solvers, to validate or refine plans; (4) Reflection and refinement: learning from failed attempts to improve future planning decisions; (5) Memory-augmented planning: storing past experiences or solutions to inform future reasoning, similar to a developer maintaining a personal knowledge base.
paragraphs.zh: 对于更复杂的任务，规划功能使大型语言模型能够在执行前设计一系列行动步骤。 该模型不会直接跳向解决方案，而是会制定策略：“要修复这个错误，我必须先定位有问题的函数，分析其输入和输出，生成候选修复方案，逐一测试，并对照完整的测试套件进行验证。” Huang 等人 [ 11 ] 识别出五种关键的规划策略：（1）任务分解：将问题拆分为更小、更易管理的子任务；（2）多计划选择：生成多个候选计划，并挑选其中最可行的一个；（3）借助外部模块的规划：整合外部工具（如静态分析器或符号求解器），以验证或优化计划；（4）反思与改进：从失败的尝试中吸取教训，从而改善未来的规划决策；（5）增强记忆型规划：存储过往的经验或解决方案，为未来的推理提供依据，类似于开发者维护个人知识库。

paragraphs.en: To ground reasoning in real-world context, Tool Use allows LLMs to interact with external systems. These tools include code executors, web search engines, documentation APIs, and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems that retrieve relevant code examples or library documentation [ 26 ] . This capability is essential: no LLM can contain all possible APIs, frameworks, or error patterns. By accessing live, accurate information , LLMs become far more accurate and trustworthy. Just as a human developer would consult Stack Overflow or a compiler.

paragraphs.en: While these reasoning techniques have been studied broadly across problem-solving tasks, they are particularly well suited to automated debugging. Debugging inherently involves hypothesis generation, iterative validation, error localization, and decision-making under uncertainty. As a result, techniques such as step-by-step reasoning, reflection, planning, and multi-agent collaboration naturally align with the structure of the debugging process.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这些推理技术已在各类问题求解任务中得到广泛研究，但它们尤其适用于自动化调试。 调试本质上涉及假设生成、迭代验证、错误定位以及在不确定性条件下的决策。 因此，诸如逐步推理、反思、规划和多智能体协作等技术天然契合调试流程的结构。

paragraphs.en: Debugging is a reasoning-intensive process that involves hypothesis formation, validation under partial observability, and iterative refinement. Unlike code generation, which can often succeed with approximate solutions, debugging demands coherent multi-step reasoning to identify root causes and ensure that fixes are correct and non-regressive, making it particularly sensitive to the limitations of single-shot LLM outputs. Techniques that encourage step-by-step reasoning, such as Chain-of-Thought, naturally support the decomposition of debugging tasks into interpretable phases including fault localization, state inspection, and fix evaluation [ 27 ] . In practice, multiple plausible explanations often exist for the same failure. Approaches based on self-consistency mitigate this ambiguity by exploring alternative reasoning paths and favoring explanations that remain stable across independent analyses, thereby improving robustness in fault diagnosis [ 28 ] .
paragraphs.zh: 调试是一个高度依赖推理的过程，涉及假设构建、在部分可观测性条件下的验证以及迭代优化。 与代码生成不同——后者通常可以通过近似解决方案成功完成——调试需要连贯的多步推理来识别根本原因，并确保修复方案既正确又不会导致问题恶化，因此它对单次生成式大语言模型输出的局限性尤为敏感。 鼓励逐步推理的技术（如“思维链”方法）天然支持将调试任务分解为可解释的阶段，包括故障定位、状态检查和修复评估 [ 27 ] 。 在实践中，同一故障往往存在多种合理的解释。 基于自洽性的方法通过探索替代性推理路径，并优先选择在不同独立分析中保持一致的解释，从而缓解这种模糊性，进而提升故障诊断的稳健性 [ 28 ] 。

paragraphs.en: Debugging is also an iterative activity, where initial fixes may be incomplete or introduce new errors. Reflection-based methods enable LLMs to assess the quality of their own outputs, revise faulty assumptions, and refine patches over successive attempts [ 29 ] . When combined with planning-oriented reasoning, models can adopt a more global debugging strategy, deciding which components to inspect, how to sequence analysis steps, and when to reconsider earlier hypotheses, particularly in large or interdependent codebases. Effective debugging further requires grounding reasoning in concrete evidence. Tool-augmented approaches allow LLMs to incorporate compiler diagnostics, execution traces, test results, or external documentation into their reasoning process, reducing speculative conclusions and increasing the reliability of generated fixes [ 26 ] . Finally, multi-agent reasoning frameworks reflect the collaborative nature of human debugging by distributing analysis across specialized agents, enabling parallel hypothesis generation, cross-verification, and conflict resolution.
paragraphs.zh: 调试也是一种迭代活动，初始的修复可能并不完整，甚至可能引入新的错误。 基于反思的方法使大型语言模型能够评估自身输出的质量，修正错误的假设，并在连续尝试中不断完善修复方案 [ 29 ] 。 当与规划导向的推理相结合时，模型可以采用更具全局性的调试策略，决定检查哪些组件、如何安排分析步骤以及何时重新考虑早期的假设，尤其是在大型或相互依赖的代码库中。 有效的调试还需要将推理建立在具体的证据之上。 借助工具的方法允许大型语言模型将编译器诊断信息、执行轨迹、测试结果或外部文档纳入其推理过程，从而减少推测性结论，提高所生成修复方案的可靠性 [ 26 ] 。 最后，多智能体推理框架通过将分析任务分配给专门的智能体，体现了人类调试的协作性质，从而实现假设的并行生成、交叉验证和冲突解决。

paragraphs.en: refers to the structure and abstraction level of the objectives an agent must achieve. Highly agentic systems do not merely follow simple commands; they handle vague or underspecified instructions by decomposing them into sequences of interdependent subgoals. This requires hierarchical reasoning and planning, capabilities that align with longstanding work in AI on task decomposition and modular goal representation. Recent advances in LLMs have made this practical: using techniques like Chain-of-Thought prompting [ 24 ] , LLMs can now interpret high-level requests and autonomously generate detailed, multi-step plans to fulfill them.
paragraphs.zh: 指智能体必须完成的目标的结构和抽象层次。 高度具备智能体能力的系统不会仅仅遵循简单的命令；它们会通过将模糊或未充分说明的指令分解为相互依赖的子目标序列来处理这些指令。 这需要层级推理和规划，而这些能力与人工智能领域长期以来在任务分解和模块化目标表示方面的研究相一致。 大型语言模型（LLM）的最新进展使这一方法变得可行：通过运用“思维链”提示 [24] 等技术，LLM 现在能够解释高级别请求，并自主生成详细的、多步骤的计划来实现这些请求。

paragraphs.en: captures the challenges posed by the contexts in which agents operate. Real-world environments are rarely static or fully observable; they may involve dynamic codebases, interactive user inputs, partial information, or concurrent multi-agent interactions. Agentic systems must perceive, interpret, and respond to such uncertainty while maintaining goal-directed behavior [ 31 ] . This means handling ambiguous inputs, adapting to shifting constraints, and reasoning about consequences in settings where feedback is delayed or incomplete, capabilities that go far beyond simple input-output mapping.
paragraphs.zh: 捕捉了智能体运行环境所带来的挑战。 现实世界的环境很少是静态或完全可观测的；它们可能涉及动态的代码库、交互式用户输入、部分信息，或并发多智能体交互。 智能体系统必须感知、解释并应对这种不确定性，同时保持以目标为导向的行为 [ 31 ] 。 这意味着要处理模糊的输入，适应不断变化的约束条件，并在反馈延迟或不完整的场景中对后果进行推理——这些能力远远超出了简单的输入-输出映射。

paragraphs.en: is the system’s ability to adjust its strategy in response to new information, task variations, or performance feedback. Rather than executing fixed procedures, agentic systems learn from experience, transfer insights across tasks, and refine their behavior on the fly. Modern LLMs exhibit this through mechanisms like in-context learning, where they infer patterns from a few examples without parameter updates; few-shot learning, which enables rapid adaptation to new domains; and meta-learning, where models learn how to learn efficiently across related tasks [ 32 ] . paragraphs.en: is the hallmark of true agency: the capacity to pursue goals autonomously, without step-by-step human intervention. This includes monitoring progress toward a goal, detecting failures, generating new subgoals as needed, and revising plans when obstacles arise. Systems such as AutoGPT [ 33 ] demonstrate this by chaining together reasoning, tool use, and self-correction over multiple steps to complete open-ended tasks. In the context of program repair, independent execution means an agent can start from a failing test, diagnose the root cause, propose and validate fixes, and iterate, all without external guidance.
paragraphs.zh: 是真正智能体的标志：即能够自主追求目标，无需人类一步步干预。 这包括监控目标进展、检测失败、根据需要生成新的子目标，以及在出现障碍时修订计划。 像 AutoGPT [ 33 ] 这样的系统通过多个步骤将推理、工具使用和自我纠正串联起来，从而完成开放式任务，展现了这一特性。 在程序修复的语境中，独立执行意味着一个智能体可以从失败的测试开始，诊断根本原因，提出并验证修复方案，并不断迭代，而无需外部指导。

paragraphs.en: When evaluated through the lens of agenticness [ 30 ] , current LLM-based debugging systems exhibit uneven capabilities across its four dimensions. Most work strongly addresses goal complexity, using advanced reasoning to solve increasingly sophisticated debugging tasks. Some systems also engage with environmental complexity, particularly those that integrate IDE tools, debuggers, or repository-wide context to ground their reasoning in real-world software structures. However, adaptability and independent execution remain largely underdeveloped. Nearly all existing approaches apply the same static workflow to every bug, regardless of difficulty. This leads to two problems: first, simple bugs such as syntax errors are processed with excessive overhead, incurring unnecessary computational cost; second, for complex bugs, fixed agent configurations may lack the right mix of specialists, limiting repair quality. Moreover, in multi-agent settings, static designs often cause agents to drift from the core objective, especially during extended interactions, which can degrade performance unpredictably. In summary, most current systems operate as reactive tools: they target narrowly defined repair objectives, assume a fixed debugging environment, follow predetermined workflows, and require substantial external control or manual intervention. As a result, they exhibit limited agenticness when confronted with complex bugs that demand adaptive reasoning and flexible coordination. This motivates the need for debugging systems that can interpret high-level repair goals, respond to diverse program contexts, adapt their internal structure to task difficulty, and execute repairs with minimal supervision. To address the challenges of debugging with varying code complexity, we introduce ASAD, an adaptive agentic framework designed to allocate the reasoning and collaboration efforts proportionally to the difficulty of the problem. The approach aims to balance efficiency and effectiveness by using lightweight reasoning for simple bugs while coordinating multiple specialized agents for complex cases. In this section, we start by presenting the overall architecture, then we present its components and the mechanisms that enable adaptive agent deployment and iterative refinement.
paragraphs.zh: 从智能体性 [ 30 ] 的角度进行评估时，当前的基于大型语言模型的调试系统在这四个维度上的能力表现并不均衡。 大多数研究都高度关注目标复杂性，通过高级推理来解决日益复杂的调试任务。 一些系统还会应对环境复杂性，尤其是那些集成了 IDE 工具、调试器或整个代码库上下文信息，从而将推理建立在真实软件结构之上的系统。 然而，适应性和独立执行能力在很大程度上仍未得到充分发展。 几乎所有现有方法都对每个错误应用相同的静态工作流程，而不管其难度如何。 这导致了两个问题：首先，语法错误等简单错误需要过度处理，产生了不必要的计算成本；其次，对于复杂错误，固定的智能体配置可能缺乏合适的专家组合，从而限制了修复质量。 此外，在多智能体设置中，静态设计常常导致智能体偏离核心目标，尤其是在长时间交互过程中，这可能会不可预测地降低性能。 总而言之，大多数现有系统都作为反应式工具运行：它们针对狭义定义的修复目标，假设固定的调试环境，遵循预定的工作流程，并且需要大量的外部控制或人工干预。 因此，当面对需要适应性推理和灵活协调的复杂错误时，这些系统表现出有限的智能体性。 这促使我们开发能够解释高级修复目标、响应多样化程序上下文、根据任务难度调整内部结构并以最小监督执行修复的调试系统。 为了解决不同代码复杂度下调试的挑战，我们提出了 ASAD——一个自适应智能体框架，旨在根据问题难度成比例地分配推理和协作资源。 该方法旨在通过为简单错误使用轻量级推理，同时为复杂情况协调多个专业智能体，来实现效率与效果之间的平衡。 在本节中，我们将首先介绍整体架构，然后阐述其各个组件以及实现智能体自适应部署和迭代优化的机制。

paragraphs.en: To be truly adaptive, a system must adjust its strategy based on the characteristics of each problem it encounters. Rather than following a fixed sequence of steps, it should analyze the task, decide how much reasoning is needed, and determine which agents should be involved. We achieve this principle by using the reasoning capabilities of LLMs to assess the buggy code, formulate a plan, and dynamically configure agent roles and interactions. paragraphs.en: At its core, our system integrates three complementary reasoning techniques: planning, iterative reflection, and multi-agent collaboration. The system’s behavior depends on the assessed complexity of the bug. For complex problems, it follows a decomposition-first approach [ 11 ] . A central main agent first analyzes the bug, decomposes the debugging task into structured subtasks, and designs a coordination plan. It then instantiates specialized agents, assigns each a role, and orchestrates their execution. After agents complete their subtasks, they report their results back to the main agent. Based on this feedback, the main agent may initiate another round of refinement or finalize the solution. For simple problems, such as minor syntax errors, the system bypasses multi-agent coordination entirely. Instead, the main agent attempts a direct, single-pass repair, avoiding unnecessary overhead. In all cases, the final output undergoes an attentive validation before outputting the solution. The main agent performs a final check to ensure the correctness of the code and decides whether to go for a new iteration, refining its approach based on the observed failure. In the following sections, we detail the role, tasks and behaviors of the main agent and the specialized agents it can deploy.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的系统核心整合了三种互补的推理技术：规划、迭代反思和多智能体协作。 系统的行为取决于对漏洞复杂性的评估结果。 对于复杂问题，系统会优先采用分解策略 [ 11 ] 。 一个核心的主智能体首先分析漏洞，将调试任务分解为结构化的子任务，并设计协调计划。 随后，它会实例化专用智能体，为每个智能体分配角色，并协调它们的执行过程。 智能体完成子任务后，会将结果反馈给主智能体。 基于这些反馈，主智能体可能启动新一轮优化，或最终确定解决方案。 对于简单问题（如轻微的语法错误），系统会完全跳过多智能体协作环节。 取而代之的是，主智能体会尝试直接的一次性修复，避免不必要的额外开销。 在所有情况下，最终输出在呈现解决方案前都会经过细致的验证。 主智能体执行最终检查以确保代码正确性，并决定是否启动新一轮迭代，根据观察到的失败情况优化其方法。 在接下来的部分中，我们将详细说明主智能体及其可部署的专用智能体的角色、任务与行为。

paragraphs.en: The process begins with a structured code analysis phase, where the main agent identifies and categorizes defects in the input program. To reduce reliance on purely subjective judgment, we augment the agent’s input with a lightweight static analysis report that provides objective indicators of program structure and potential debugging difficulty. This analysis extracts five complementary dimensions that characterize the complexity of the buggy program: (1) Error Severity , approximated by the number of failing test cases and if available, the runtime or compilation errors observed during execution; (2) Source-location difficulty , measured using the Abstract Syntax Tree (AST) depth of the affected code region and the number of non-commenting lines of code (NLOC) in the relevant function; (3) Program-understanding difficulty , captured through structural properties such as cyclomatic complexity and AST branching factor; (4) System-level operations , identified by the presence of concurrency constructs or resource-management-related API usage; and (5) Inter-function dependencies , quantified via call-graph fan-in and fan-out within the file.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程首先进行结构化的代码分析阶段，在此阶段，主智能体将识别并分类输入程序中的缺陷。 为减少对纯粹主观判断的依赖，我们在智能体的输入中补充了一份轻量级静态分析报告，该报告提供了程序结构和潜在调试难度的客观指标。 此分析提取了五个相互补充的维度，用以描述含错程序的复杂性：(1) 错误严重程度，通过失败的测试用例数量以及（如果可用）执行过程中观察到的运行时或编译错误来近似估算；(2) 源定位难度，通过受影响代码区域的抽象语法树（AST）深度以及相关函数中非注释代码行的数量（NLOC）来衡量；(3) 程序理解难度，通过结构特性（如圈复杂度与 AST 分支因子）来体现；(4) 系统级操作，通过并发结构或资源管理相关 API 的使用情况来识别；以及 (5) 函数间依赖关系，通过文件内的调用图扇入和扇出进行量化。

paragraphs.en: These metrics are not used independently, but are provided jointly to the main agent as structured evidence about the nature of the debugging task. The agent reasons over these signals to estimate whether the problem can be resolved through a lightweight single-step repair or requires a more structured multi-agent decomposition. If the aggregated evidence indicates low complexity, the system proceeds with a direct repair strategy using a single-pass attempt by the main agent. Otherwise, the task is classified as complex, triggering the generation of a multi-step debugging plan and the instantiation of specialized agents. This decision forms the basis of the adaptive orchestration mechanism that guides the remainder of the debugging process.
paragraphs.zh: 这些指标并非独立使用，而是作为关于调试任务性质的结构化证据，共同提供给主智能体。 智能体会基于这些信号进行推理，以判断问题能否通过轻量级的单步修复解决，还是需要更结构化的多智能体分解。 如果汇总后的证据表明复杂性较低，系统便会采用直接修复策略，由主智能体进行一次尝试。 否则，该任务将被归类为复杂任务，从而触发多步骤调试计划的生成以及专用智能体的实例化。 这一决策构成了自适应协调机制的基础，该机制将指导后续整个调试流程。

paragraphs.en: When the main agent determines that a problem requires multi-agent decomposition, it generates a structured set of specialized agent profiles. Each profile defines a well-scoped debugging responsibility and serves as an executable specification for instantiating an agent. Formally, each agent profile consists of three components: (1) Role , which defines the debugging function; (2) Objective , which specifies the targeted class of issues to be resolved; and (3) Execution Constraints , which define the scope of allowed modifications. Once profiles are generated, the main agent determines an execution order over the instantiated agents. paragraphs.en: In the specialized agents execution phase, the system does not dispatch all agents at once. By enforcing quality checks at each step, it ensures that time and computational resources are not spent propagating errors, especially when early agents fail to fully resolve the issue.

paragraphs.en: Once all agents have completed their tasks, or if a simple fix path was followed, the main agent performs a final validation, assessing whether the code is now free of issues. If the code is validated as corrected, the system outputs the corrected version to the user. However, if the issue persists, a failure log is generated (including the remaining issues) and passed back to the analysis step. This triggers a new iteration with a revised strategy, which could alter the agent configuration, prompts, or priorities. To avoid having the system on the same plan as in the previous iteration, we explicitly prompt the main agent to propose a debugging strategy that is different from the ones in the previous iterations. The process repeats until the issue is fixed or the system reaches a maximum of 5 iterations.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦所有智能体完成其任务，或者如果采用了简单的修复路径，主智能体就会执行最终验证，评估代码是否已无问题。 如果代码经验证为已修正，系统就会将修正后的版本输出给用户。 然而，如果问题仍然存在，系统将生成一个失败日志（包括剩余的问题），并将其返回到分析步骤。 这会触发一轮新的迭代，采用修订后的策略，该策略可能会改变智能体的配置、提示或优先级。 为避免系统沿用上一轮迭代中的相同计划，我们明确提示主智能体提出与之前各轮迭代不同的调试策略。 此过程将持续重复，直到问题得到解决，或者系统达到最多 5 次迭代的限制。

paragraphs.en: If the analysis deems the problem simple, the main agent attempts a direct fix using its internal reasoning capabilities. This is done through a targeted prompt that instructs the agent to correct the identified issue without invoking additional agents. The prompt typically includes the buggy code, a summary of the detected errors, and a directive to produce a corrected version of the code in a single pass. The output of this fix is then passed directly to the validation phase, where it is assessed for correctness. This strategy avoids unnecessary agent deployment and reduces coordination overhead, streamlining the resolution of straightforward issues.

paragraphs.en: Once the execution strategy is determined, ASAD initializes the corresponding agents by loading their profiles, assigning code context, and ordering them according to the dependency structure defined during planning. To balance adaptability and efficiency, ASAD enforces bounded execution at two levels. At the agent level, each specialized agent is allowed up to three refinement attempts when its output is deemed insufficient by the main agent. At the system level, the entire debugging process is limited to five global iterations, where each iteration corresponds to a full cycle of analysis, planning, execution, and validation. These constraints are motivated by empirical observations of diminishing returns. Additional refinement beyond three attempts per agent rarely improves repair quality while increasing computational cost. Similarly, most successful repairs occur within five global iterations, after which additional cycles yield marginal improvements. This design ensures that ASAD remains both computationally tractable and robust across varying levels of debugging complexity.

paragraphs.en: Specialized agents are instantiated based on the profiles generated by the main agent after analyzing the problem. Each agent has a specific role to perform a particular debugging task. Rather than executing in parallel, agents operate sequentially under the supervision of the main agent. After completing its task, each agent returns a report summarizing its actions and observations. The main agent reviews this report before deciding whether to proceed to the next agent or request further refinement. This review-driven execution protocol enhances robustness by allowing corrections at each step and helps prevent error propagation throughout the debugging process.

paragraphs.en: In this study, we aim to answer the following research questions (RQs):

paragraphs.en: We investigate whether ASAD improves bug-fixing performance relative to traditional prompting and fixed multi-agent approaches. This involves analyzing the accuracy of generated fixes and the proportion of correctly resolved bugs across benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: 我们研究 ASAD 相较于传统提示方法和固定的多智能体方法，在错误修复性能上是否存在提升。 这包括分析所生成修复的准确性，以及各基准测试中正确解决错误的比例。

sents.en: We investigate whether ASAD improves bug-fixing performance relative to traditional prompting and fixed multi-agent approaches.
sents.zh: 我们研究 ASAD 相较于传统提示方法和固定的多智能体方法，在错误修复性能上是否存在提升。

sents.en: This involves analyzing the accuracy of generated fixes and the proportion of correctly resolved bugs across benchmarks.
sents.zh: 这包括分析所生成修复的准确性，以及各基准测试中正确解决错误的比例。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate whether the system dynamically adjusts the number and roles of agents based on bug complexity, allocating more resources to harder cases while remaining efficient on simpler ones. We further measure inference time and token usage against fixed multi-agent and single-shot baselines to quantify the performance–cost trade-off.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估该系统是否会根据错误的复杂程度动态调整智能体的数量与角色，为更复杂的案例分配更多资源，同时保持处理简单案例时的效率。 我们还通过对比固定多智能体模型和单次推理基线模型，测量推理时间和令牌使用量，以量化性能与成本之间的权衡关系。

paragraphs.en: We analyze how adaptive agent selection affects the effectiveness–efficiency trade-off by comparing it against fixed-agent configurations across benchmarks and complexity levels. We also examine individual agent contributions by identifying which positions most often produce the first correct patch and how later agents refine or validate solutions, distinguishing gains from adaptation versus simply increasing agent count.
paragraphs.zh: 我们通过将自适应智能体选择与固定智能体配置在不同基准和复杂度水平上进行比较，分析其对有效性与效率权衡的影响。 我们还通过识别哪些位置最常产生首个正确补丁，以及后续智能体如何改进或验证解决方案，来考察单个智能体的贡献，从而区分收益源于自适应还是单纯增加智能体数量。

paragraphs.en: We first study how different LLMs affect the system effectiveness and efficiency, evaluating the generalizability of its adaptive design across model architectures. Then, we analyze the consistency of results across repeated tests to assess the robustness of the system under stochastic LLM behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 我们首先研究不同大型语言模型（LLM）如何影响系统的有效性和效率，并评估其自适应设计在不同模型架构下的泛化能力。 接着，我们分析重复测试中结果的一致性，以评估系统在随机 LLM 行为下的稳健性。

paragraphs.en: We conduct our experiments on three widely used debugging benchmarks: DebugBench, Defects4J and CodeFlaws These benchmarks collectively cover multiple programming languages (Python, Java, C, and C++) and diverse bug categories, allowing for a comprehensive evaluation of our system across different settings.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在三个广泛使用的调试基准数据集上进行了实验：DebugBench、Defects4J 和 CodeFlaws。这些基准数据集共同涵盖了多种编程语言（Python、Java、C 和 C++）以及不同类型的错误，从而使我们能够在不同场景下对系统进行全面评估。

paragraphs.en: This benchmark is designed to evaluate the debugging capabilities of LLMs. It consists of 4,253 instances covering four major bug categories: syntax, reference, logic, and multiple bugs; across C++, Java, and Python. The dataset is constructed by collecting correct code snippets from the LeetCode community and systematically injecting bugs using GPT-4 while maintaining rigorous quality control. DebugBench addresses limitations in prior debugging benchmarks, such as data leakage, limited dataset scale, and insufficient bug diversity. It enables systematic assessment of LLM debugging performance under zero-shot conditions, highlighting strengths and weaknesses across error types.
paragraphs.zh: 该基准测试旨在评估大型语言模型（LLM）的调试能力。 它包含 4,253 个实例，涵盖四大类错误：语法错误、引用错误、逻辑错误和多重错误，涉及 C++、Java 和 Python 三种语言。 该数据集通过从 LeetCode 社区收集正确的代码片段，并使用 GPT-4 系统性地注入错误来构建，同时保持严格的质量控制。 DebugBench 解决了先前调试基准测试中的局限性，例如数据泄露、数据集规模有限以及错误类型多样性不足等问题。 它使得在零样本条件下对 LLM 的调试性能进行系统性评估成为可能，并揭示了其在不同错误类型上的优势与劣势。

paragraphs.en: One of the most established benchmarks for evaluating fault localization and program repair in Java. As of version 3.0.1, it contains 854 reproducible bugs drawn from 17 widely used open-source Java projects, including JFreeChart, Closure Compiler, Gson, Jackson, and Mockito. Each bug includes a buggy and fixed version, isolated to ensure that changes are limited to the fix itself. The dataset is accompanied by test suites, ensuring that at least one test case fails on the buggy version and passes on the fixed one. Defects4J supports reproducible research and provides metadata facilitating empirical studies on patch size, bug localization, and fix patterns. On average, patches are small and localized, typically around four lines in a single file.
paragraphs.zh: 这是评估 Java 程序中故障定位和程序修复的最成熟基准之一。 截至 3.0.1 版本，该数据集包含 854 个可复现的缺陷，这些缺陷来自 17 个广泛使用的开源 Java 项目，包括 JFreeChart、Closure Compiler、Gson、Jackson 和 Mockito。 每个缺陷都包含一个有缺陷的版本和一个修复后的版本，并且经过隔离处理，以确保改动仅限于修复本身。 该数据集还附带了测试套件，确保至少有一个测试用例在存在缺陷的版本中失败，而在修复后的版本中通过。 Defects4J 支持可复现的研究，并提供元数据以方便对补丁大小、缺陷定位和修复模式进行实证研究。 平均而言，这些补丁规模较小且定位明确，通常仅涉及单个文件中的大约四行代码。

paragraphs.en: A large-scale benchmark for automated program repair in C, consisting of 3,902 real-world bugs collected from programming contest submissions. These bugs are classified into 39 syntactic difference-based defect classes, capturing a wide range of common programming errors. CodeFlaws facilitates objective comparison of different repair tools and enables the study of relationships between fault types and repair effectiveness. It includes buggy and corrected program versions, extensive test suites, and metadata from competitive programming contexts, making it a valuable resource for evaluating automated debugging and program repair techniques.
paragraphs.zh: 一个针对 C 语言程序自动修复的大规模基准测试，包含从编程竞赛提交中收集的 3902 个真实世界中的错误。 这些错误被分类为 39 种基于语法差异的缺陷类别，涵盖了广泛常见的编程错误。 CodeFlaws 促进了不同修复工具之间的客观比较，并支持研究故障类型与修复效果之间的关系。 它包含了带错误的程序版本和已修正的版本、全面的测试套件以及来自竞赛编程环境的元数据，使其成为评估自动调试和程序修复技术的重要资源。

paragraphs.en: To assess the performance of our system, we focus on three main aspects: the bug fix rate, which measures how often the system successfully repairs buggy programs; adaptability, which captures how the system adjusts its strategy based on bug complexity; and computational overhead, which evaluates the resources and time required to perform repairs. We present each metric in the following paragraphs.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们系统的性能，我们重点关注三个主要方面：错误修复率（衡量系统成功修复有缺陷程序的情况频率）、适应性（反映系统如何根据错误的复杂程度调整策略）以及计算开销（评估执行修复所需的资源和时间）。 我们将在接下来的段落中逐一介绍各项指标。

sents.en: To assess the performance of our system, we focus on three main aspects: the bug fix rate, which measures how often the system successfully repairs buggy programs; adaptability, which captures how the system adjusts its strategy based on bug complexity; and computational overhead, which evaluates the resources and time required to perform repairs.
sents.zh: 为了评估我们系统的性能，我们重点关注三个主要方面：错误修复率（衡量系统成功修复有缺陷程序的情况频率）、适应性（反映系统如何根据错误的复杂程度调整策略）以及计算开销（评估执行修复所需的资源和时间）。

sents.en: We present each metric in the following paragraphs.
sents.zh: 我们将在接下来的段落中逐一介绍各项指标。

paragraphs.en: The bug fix rate is the primary metric used to evaluate the effectiveness of the system. It measures the proportion of buggy instances that are successfully repaired by the system, where a repair is considered successful if the generated patch compiles and passes all available test cases in the benchmark suite. Thus, for DebugBench and CodeFlaws, a fix is counted as correct only when the generated code passes the complete test suite provided by the benchmark. For Defects4J, following standard practice in automated program repair [ 15 ] , we distinguish between two related but distinct notions: plausible fixes and correct fixes .
paragraphs.zh: 漏洞修复率是用于评估系统有效性的主要指标。 它衡量了系统中成功修复的含漏洞实例的比例，其中，如果生成的补丁能够通过编译并跑过基准测试套件中所有可用的测试用例，则视为修复成功。 因此，对于 DebugBench 和 CodeFlaws，只有当生成的代码通过基准测试提供的完整测试套件时，该修复才会被计为正确。 对于 Defects4J，遵循自动化程序修复领域的标准做法 [15]，我们区分两个相关但不同的概念：可信修复和正确修复。

sents.zh: 漏洞修复率是用于评估系统有效性的主要指标。

sents.en: It measures the proportion of buggy instances that are successfully repaired by the system, where a repair is considered successful if the generated patch compiles and passes all available test cases in the benchmark suite.

sents.en: Thus, for DebugBench and CodeFlaws, a fix is counted as correct only when the generated code passes the complete test suite provided by the benchmark.
sents.zh: 因此，对于 DebugBench 和 CodeFlaws，只有当生成的代码通过基准测试提供的完整测试套件时，该修复才会被计为正确。

sents.en: For Defects4J, following standard practice in automated program repair [ 15 ] , we distinguish between two related but distinct notions: plausible fixes and correct fixes .
sents.zh: 对于 Defects4J，遵循自动化程序修复领域的标准做法 [15]，我们区分两个相关但不同的概念：可信修复和正确修复。

paragraphs.en: Plausible Fix: A generated patch that compiles successfully and passes all available regression test cases in the benchmark suite. This indicates that the patch is functionally consistent with the test specifications, but does not guarantee correctness beyond the observed tests.
paragraphs.zh: 可信修复：一个成功编译并通过基准测试套件中所有可用回归测试用例的生成补丁。 这表明该补丁在功能上与测试规范一致，但并不保证其在未观察到的测试之外的正确性。

sents.en: Plausible Fix: A generated patch that compiles successfully and passes all available regression test cases in the benchmark suite.
sents.zh: 可信修复：一个成功编译并通过基准测试套件中所有可用回归测试用例的生成补丁。

sents.en: This indicates that the patch is functionally consistent with the test specifications, but does not guarantee correctness beyond the observed tests.
sents.zh: 这表明该补丁在功能上与测试规范一致，但并不保证其在未观察到的测试之外的正确性。

paragraphs.en: Correct Fix: A plausible fix that is equivalent to the ground-truth developer patch in terms of behavior with respect to the benchmark test suite. In practice, this is operationalized as a patch that passes all test cases and is functionally equivalent to the developer-provided solution, when such reference is available. Otherwise, correctness is determined by the benchmark’s official evaluation protocol when it provides additional validation criteria beyond the public test suite.
paragraphs.zh: 正确修复：一种合理的修复方案，其行为在与基准测试套件相关的方面与真实开发者补丁等效。 在实践中，这具体表现为一个能够通过所有测试用例且功能上与开发者提供的解决方案等效的补丁（如果存在此类参考方案）。 否则，正确性将由基准测试的官方评估协议确定，前提是该协议提供了超出公开测试套件的额外验证标准。

sents.en: Correct Fix: A plausible fix that is equivalent to the ground-truth developer patch in terms of behavior with respect to the benchmark test suite.
sents.zh: 正确修复：一种合理的修复方案，其行为在与基准测试套件相关的方面与真实开发者补丁等效。

sents.en: Otherwise, correctness is determined by the benchmark’s official evaluation protocol when it provides additional validation criteria beyond the public test suite.
sents.zh: 否则，正确性将由基准测试的官方评估协议确定，前提是该协议提供了超出公开测试套件的额外验证标准。

paragraphs.en: Reporting both metrics is important: plausible fixes indicate how often a system produces candidates that satisfy all available test cases in the benchmark, while correct fixes capture true reliability by ensuring semantic equivalence with the developer’s intended solution.
paragraphs.zh: 同时报告这两项指标非常重要：合理的修复方案表明系统有多频繁地生成能够通过基准测试中所有可用测试用例的候选方案，而正确的修复方案则通过确保与开发者预期的解决方案在语义上等价，从而体现真正的可靠性。

paragraphs.en: Adaptability is crucial for an agentic system that dynamically assigns roles based on task complexity. We measure how effectively the system tailors its debugging strategy, including the number of agents created and iterations performed, in response to varying levels of complexity. We evaluate adaptability by analyzing trends in agent usage across different types of bugs.
paragraphs.zh: 对于能够根据任务复杂程度动态分配角色的智能体系统而言，适应性至关重要。 我们通过衡量系统针对不同复杂程度的任务，在调试策略调整方面的有效性来评估其表现，包括所创建的智能体数量以及执行的迭代次数。 我们通过对不同类型缺陷中智能体使用趋势的分析，来评估系统的适应性。

sents.en: Adaptability is crucial for an agentic system that dynamically assigns roles based on task complexity.
sents.zh: 对于能够根据任务复杂程度动态分配角色的智能体系统而言，适应性至关重要。

sents.zh: 我们通过衡量系统针对不同复杂程度的任务，在调试策略调整方面的有效性来评估其表现，包括所创建的智能体数量以及执行的迭代次数。

sents.zh: 我们通过对不同类型缺陷中智能体使用趋势的分析，来评估系统的适应性。

paragraphs.en: While adaptability and bug fix rate are important, efficiency must also be considered. We evaluate the computational cost incurred by the adaptive design in comparison to fixed multi-agent or single-shot debugging approaches. This is measured in terms of inference time, token consumption. We track the number of iterations required to reach a solution, as well as the computational resources used by the main and specialized agents.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然适应性和错误修复率很重要，但效率也必须考虑在内。 我们将自适应设计所产生的计算成本与固定多智能体或单次调试方法进行比较评估。 这通过推理时间和令牌消耗来衡量。 我们追踪达到解决方案所需的迭代次数，以及主智能体和专用智能体所消耗的计算资源。

paragraphs.en: We compare our system against both prompting-based methods and state-of-the-art agentic program repair systems to isolate the benefit of adaptive orchestration from improvements in prompting strategies or underlying model capability. Specifically, we evaluate Zero-shot , Chain-of-Thought (CoT) , and four recent static agentic repair systems: ChatRepair [ 34 ] , FixAgent [ 6 ] , AdverIntent-Agent [ 35 ] , and Repair-Agent [ 36 ] . These baselines cover strong non-adaptive approaches spanning single-prompt, conversational, and fixed multi-agent paradigms. We further compare against three internal ablation variants to isolate the effect of adaptive routing in our system. All variants preserve the same multi-agent framework but remove dynamic decision-making: (i) ASAD-Lite , which always uses a minimal single-agent configuration; (ii) ASAD-Fixed , which generates a fixed set of three specialized agents regardless of bug complexity; and (iii) ASAD-Max , which always activates the maximum number of agents.

paragraphs.en: To assess whether the Main Agent’s routing decisions track bug complexity, we independently characterize the complexity of each faulty program. For each bug, we identify the buggy-side region affected by the ground-truth fix and compute two measures on that region: the number of changed lines, representing the repair scope, and Halstead Effort, capturing the complexity of the affected code. We use the predefined easy, medium, and hard instances in DebugBench to establish the corresponding complexity ranges and apply the same characterization consistently across CodeFlaws, and Defects4J.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估主智能体的路由决策是否反映了错误的复杂性，我们独立地描述了每个有缺陷程序的复杂性。 对于每个错误，我们确定受真实修复影响的错误侧区域，并计算该区域的两个指标：代表修复范围的更改行数，以及反映受影响代码复杂性的哈勒斯特德努力度。 我们使用 DebugBench 中预定义的简单、中等和困难实例来确定相应的复杂性范围，并在 CodeFlaws 和 Defects4J 中一致地应用相同的描述方法。

paragraphs.en: We built ASAD as a modular Python framework that integrates LLMs inside an adaptive, multi-agent system for debugging. The system consists of a central controller and multiple agent modules, which collaborate to analyze buggy programs, classify their complexity, and generate repair strategies. For open-source models, we used Together.ai. For proprietary models such as GPT-5, we used their official APIs. Agents communicate through structured prompts and return their output in a standardized format. To handle interactions between agents, we used task-oriented, role-based prompts with structured output instructions. These prompts ensure consistent, structured communication between the system components and the language models. paragraphs.en: Table I reports the bug-fix rates achieved by ASAD across all benchmarks, programming languages, and LLMs, compared with Zero-shot and Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting.
paragraphs.zh: 表 I 报告了 ASAD 在所有基准测试、编程语言和大型语言模型（LLM）中实现的错误修复率，并与零样本提示和思维链（CoT）提示进行了比较。

paragraphs.en: Across all evaluated settings, ASAD consistently outperforms both prompting baselines. The improvements are observed for every benchmark. On DebugBench, ASAD raises the average bug-fix rate from 52.7%–58.9% under Zero-shot prompting and 59.1%–63.8% under CoT prompting to 71.6%–77.9%. Depending on the underlying LLM, this corresponds to absolute improvements of approximately 17–19 percentage points over Zero-shot and 12–14 percentage points over CoT. Similar gains are observed across Python, C++, and Java, indicating that the adaptive strategy remains effective regardless of programming language.
paragraphs.zh: 在所有评估设置中，ASAD 的表现始终优于两种提示基线方法。 在每一项基准测试中都观察到了这种改进。 在 DebugBench 上，ASAD 将平均缺陷修复率从零样本提示下的 52.7%–58.9% 和 CoT 提示下的 59.1%–63.8% 提升至 71.6%–77.9%。 具体取决于底层的 LLM，这相当于相比零样本提示提升了约 17–19 个百分点，相比 CoT 提示提升了 12–14 个百分点。 在 Python、C++ 和 Java 中也都观察到了类似的提升，表明这种自适应策略在不同编程语言中依然有效。

paragraphs.en: Defects4J represents the most challenging benchmark, containing real-world Java bugs that often require long-range reasoning, semantic understanding, and project-level context. Although the absolute repair rates remain lower than those achieved on DebugBench and CodeFlaws, ASAD substantially improves performance across all backbone models, increasing bug-fix rates from 6.8%–10.7% (Zero-shot) and 8.5%–13.2% (CoT) to 22.1%–32.5%. This corresponds to roughly a threefold improvement over conventional prompting, demonstrating that adaptive agent selection remains effective even on realistic software repair tasks with considerably higher complexity. Overall, these results show that ASAD consistently delivers large performance gains over prompt-based baselines across all evaluated benchmarks. The improvements remain stable across four different LLM families, suggesting that the benefits arise primarily from the adaptive reasoning framework rather than the capabilities of any particular backbone model.

paragraphs.en: To quantify the impact of adaptive orchestration, we compare ASAD with three fixed-strategy baselines: ASAD-Lite, ASAD-Fixed, and ASAD-Max. Table V summarizes the results across all benchmarks and complexity levels. ASAD-Lite consistently achieves the lowest computational overhead, with execution times ranging from 15s to 29s and token usage between 1.0K and 2.1K. However, it also yields the weakest debugging performance, with fix rates ranging from 58.9% to 75.2% on DebugBench and dropping to 16.3%–26.8% on Defects4J. This confirms that relying on a single lightweight agent significantly limits effectiveness on harder debugging tasks. On the other hand, ASAD-Max achieves competitive or strong fix rates among the baselines, reaching up to 73.4%–88.3% on DebugBench and 30.5%–34.3% on Defects4J. However, this improvement comes at a substantial computational cost, with execution times up to 128s and token usage reaching 9.6K, representing a multi-fold increase over ASAD-Lite.

paragraphs.en: ASAD-Fixed provides a stable intermediate baseline, consistently improving over ASAD-Lite in terms of fix rate, but at a higher cost. Across benchmarks, it requires 72s–108s of execution time and 4.8K–7.8K tokens depending on complexity. In contrast, ASAD achieves a more balanced trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency. On CodeFlaws and Defects4J, it consistently outperforms ASAD-Max and ASAD-Fixed in fix rate (e.g., 78.3% vs. 76.4% on CodeFlaws-Medium and 29.1% vs. 26.4% on Defects4J-High). On DebugBench, ASAD is slightly below ASAD-Max in fix rate (e.g., 71.3% vs. 73.4% on High complexity), but still maintains substantially lower computational cost. Across all settings, ASAD reduces execution time by approximately 50%–80% compared to ASAD-Max, depending on benchmark difficulty, while also lowering token consumption by roughly 40%–70%. paragraphs.en: To better understand how specialized agents contribute to successful repairs, we conduct a controlled analysis on 100 randomly selected DebugBench instances successfully repaired by ASAD using exactly three specialized agents. For each instance, we record which agent first produces a patch that passes all test cases. Table VII summarizes the contribution of each agent position. The second agent is the most effective contributor, acting as the primary fixer in 54% of successful repairs. This suggests that the first agent often provides an initial but incomplete diagnosis, which the second agent leverages to produce the first correct patch. The first agent contributes 31% of successful fixes, typically by producing either partial or occasionally complete solutions early in the process. The third agent accounts for 15% of first successful fixes, but plays a dominant role in refinement, being responsible for post-fix improvement or validation in 85% of cases. These results show that the first two specialized agents account for most first successful fixes, while the third acts primarily as a refinement and verification stage. The first two specialized agents execute the majority of successful repairs, while the third acts primarily as a refinement and verification stage. These findings support ASAD’s adaptive design, which prioritizes early specialization and reserves additional reasoning capacity for when it is truly necessary.

paragraphs.en: The evaluation of ASAD demonstrates that the adaptive orchestration of LLM-based agents substantially enhances automated debugging performance across diverse benchmarks, programming languages, and model families. Unlike static multi-agent frameworks that enforce rigid pipelines, or simple prompting techniques that lack structured reasoning, ASAD dynamically configures both the number and specialization of agents based on bug complexity. This adaptivity yields massive performance gains—improving bug-fix rates by up to 25 percentage points on synthetic benchmarks and nearly tripling repair performance on the highly complex Defects4J dataset—while simultaneously reducing computational overhead by approximately 44% compared to fixed multi-agent baselines. These findings provide strong empirical evidence that dynamic, complexity-aware coordination is a critical determinant of efficiency, correctness, and robustness in LLM-based program repair. In this section, we provide a deeper analysis of these results.

paragraphs.en: Two primary mechanisms explain the observed performance gains. First, complexity-aware resource allocation ensures proportional computational utilization. As demonstrated in our resource analysis, ASAD exhibits a clear monotonic increase in agent activation, execution time, and token consumption as bug complexity grows. Trivial syntax or formatting errors are resolved with minimal overhead by activating only a single agent, while complex semantic or logical bugs trigger a cascade of specialized agents. This prevents the wasted computation inherent in fixed pipelines. Second, structured iterative refinement allows the system to perform incremental corrections. Our agent attribution analysis reveals a clear division of labor: the first agent typically provides an initial diagnosis or partial fix, the second agent acts as the primary fixer in 54% of successful repairs, and the third agent predominantly serves as a refiner and validator. This sequential specialization reduces the risk of producing test-suite overfitted patches and allows the system to converge on semantically correct solutions rather than merely compilable ones.
paragraphs.zh: 有两种主要机制可以解释所观察到的性能提升。 首先，具备复杂感知能力的资源分配确保了计算资源的比例性利用。 正如我们的资源分析所示，随着错误复杂度的增加，ASAD 的智能体激活数量、执行时间和令牌消耗均呈现出明显的单调增长趋势。 简单的语法或格式错误只需激活单个智能体即可以极低的开销解决，而复杂的语义或逻辑错误则会触发一系列专业智能体的级联响应。 这避免了固定流程中固有的计算浪费问题。 其次，结构化的迭代优化使系统能够进行逐步修正。 我们的智能体职责分析显示存在明确的分工：第一个智能体通常提供初步诊断或部分修复；在 54% 的成功修复中，第二个智能体充当主要修复者；第三个智能体则主要负责优化和验证。 这种顺序化的专业化分工降低了生成过度拟合测试用例集的补丁的风险，并使系统能够收敛到语义正确的解决方案，而不仅仅是可编译的解决方案。

paragraphs.en: The comparative analysis against both static multi-agent frameworks and standard prompting techniques underscores the absolute necessity of adaptivity. Previous multi-agent debugging systems, such as FixAgent, rely on static pipelines where the number, type, and order of agents are fixed. Our results reveal that such rigidity leads to significant inefficiencies. On Defects4J, FixAgent generated more plausible patches than ASAD but fewer correct fixes, indicating a higher incidence of test-suite overfitting and a failure to converge on true semantic correctness. Similarly, our ablation study comparing ASAD against fixed internal variants ( ASAD-Fixed and ASAD-Max ) shows that simply increasing the number of agents yields diminishing marginal returns at the cost of massive computational overhead (more than 6 × \times the token consumption of the lightweight baseline). ASAD, by contrast, matches or exceeds the fix rates of static configurations while reducing execution time and token consumption by 44%–55%.

paragraphs.en: Conversely, standard prompting techniques (Zero-shot and Chain-of-Thought) lack the structured collaboration necessary for complex debugging. This selective deployment not only improves efficiency and correctness but also prevents the over-correction and hallucination often seen in unconstrained LLM generation. Ultimately, these insights underline that dynamic, context-sensitive orchestration is vastly superior to both rigid parallelism and unstructured single-agent prompting, establishing adaptivity as the key enabler for next-generation automated debugging systems.

paragraphs.en: Data contamination in established benchmarks like Defects4J and CodeFlaws threatens the external validity of our findings, as frontier models may have encountered these datasets during pre-training. Although recent studies identify Defects4J as the benchmark with the highest overall memorization risk, they also confirm that modern models with substantially larger training budgets, specifically the Llama-3 and Mistral families used in our evaluation, exhibit significantly lower leakage risks [ 37 ] . By measuring Negative Log-Likelihood and 5-gram accuracy, researchers demonstrated that these newer models treat established benchmarks similarly to unseen code, avoiding the verbatim memorization observed in older architectures. Our own experimental results corroborate this limited memorization. If the evaluated models had simply retrieved memorized solutions for Defects4J, we would expect near-perfect repair rates. Instead, the maximum fix rate reaches only 32.5%. This imperfect performance demonstrates that the models must actively reason through complex semantic dependencies to generate valid patches. Furthermore, our adaptive approach consistently improves fix rates over static baselines across all complexity levels. If data contamination drove the performance, this adaptive orchestration would not yield such structured and consistent improvements.

paragraphs.en: In this section, we examine possible threats to the validity of our empirical findings.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将探讨可能威胁到我们实证研究结果有效性的因素。

paragraphs.en: LLMs exhibit inherent non-determinism due to stochastic decoding strategies and potential API-level variability, which may affect result stability. To mitigate this threat, we conducted five independent replications on a stratified sample of 100 DebugBench instances per model, fixing temperature parameters ( t = 0.2 t=0.2 ) and random seeds where API-supported. Performance measurements yielded a mean fix rate with a narrow standard deviation σ = 1.6 % \sigma=1.6\% across replications. Another threat concerns test-suite overfitting in repair validation. Passing benchmark test cases does not guarantee semantic correctness, particularly on Defects4J where limited coverage enables plausible but incorrect patches. We mitigated this by distinguishing plausible from correct fixes using developer-provided oracles, conducting manual inspection on all 223 patches classified as correct. Subjectivity in complexity assessment also presents another threat, as agent allocation depends on the main agent’s internal judgment without objective ground truth. We addressed this by formalizing complexity criteria into five measurable dimensions (Error Severity, Source-location difficulty, Program-understanding difficulty, System-level operations, and Inter-function dependencies.) with explicit decision thresholds, validating assessments against human judgments on 100 bugs.

paragraphs.en: The applicability of the proposed approach to other datasets constitutes an external validity threat. Results observed on a given benchmark may not generalize uniformly to other debugging datasets with different characteristics. To limit this threat, we evaluated ASAD on multiple benchmarks (DebugBench, Defects4J, and CodeFlaws) covering different programming languages, bug types, and dataset properties, thereby reducing reliance on any single benchmark. Nevertheless, the benchmarks considered in this study primarily focus on single-file or unit-level defects and do not fully capture the complexity of large industrial software systems. As a result, the effectiveness of ASAD in repository-scale settings involving multi-module dependencies, build systems, and CI/CD pipelines remains uncertain. Evaluating the approach on repository-level benchmarks and in real-world industrial environments is an important direction for future work. Generalization across LLMs represents another external threat. The evaluation included several model families available in 2025, including GPT-5, DeepSeek-V3, Gemini-1.5, and Llama-3. paragraphs.en: In this section, we review recent research on the use of LLMs for debugging, focusing on reasoning techniques as well as agent-based approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 在本节中，我们将回顾近期关于利用大型语言模型（LLM）进行调试的研究，重点探讨推理技术以及基于智能体的方法。

paragraphs.en: Recent work has explored a range of reasoning techniques to improve the debugging capabilities of LLMs. Levin et al. [ 27 ] introduce ChatDBG, a debugging assistant that applies Chain-of-Thought prompting to generate step-by-step explanations for its proposed fixes, making the reasoning process transparent and verifiable. Chen et al. [ 29 ] propose “Self-Debugging,” in which LLMs iteratively refine code based on actual execution outcomes, using runtime feedback to guide corrections. Ahmed et al. [ 28 ] enhance patch generation through Self-Consistency, producing multiple candidate fixes and selecting the most coherent or frequently occurring solution. Other approaches integrate reasoning with structured workflows. Kang et al. [ 38 ] present AutoSD, a system that formulates debugging as scientific inquiry: the LLM generates hypotheses about the bug’s root cause and then uses a debugger to test them. Similarly, Lee et al. [ 6 ] develop FixAgent, which combines multi-agent collaboration and tool use to mimic real developer workflows, separating diagnosis, patching, and validation into distinct phases. To further extend reasoning, recent systems embed retrieval, planning, and tool interaction directly into the inference loop. Chen et al. [ 26 ] integrate retrieval into multi-step reasoning, allowing LLMs to dynamically fetch and incorporate external knowledge during problem solving. Yan et al. [ 39 ] combine reflection with tool execution, using both intra-agent self-critique and inter-agent feedback to revise plans before and after invoking tools. Finally, Schick et al. [ 40 ] demonstrate that tool invocation can be learned and embedded directly into the LLM’s generation process, enabling the model to reason through executing code, observing outcomes, and updating its plan in response.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究探索了多种推理技术，以提升大型语言模型（LLM）的调试能力。Levin 等人 [ 27 ] 提出了 ChatDBG，这是一款调试助手，它通过应用“思维链”提示方法，为提出的修复方案生成分步解释，使推理过程透明且可验证。Chen 等人 [ 29 ] 提出了“自我调试”方法，其中 LLM 会根据实际执行结果迭代优化代码，并利用运行时反馈指导修正。Ahmed 等人 [ 28 ] 通过“自我一致性”方法增强了补丁生成能力，即生成多个候选修复方案，并选择其中最连贯或出现频率最高的解决方案。 其他方法则将推理与结构化工作流程相结合。Kang 等人 [ 38 ] 提出了 AutoSD，该系统将调试过程建模为科学探究：LLM 会生成关于错误根本原因的假设，然后使用调试器进行验证。同样地，Lee 等人 [ 6 ] 开发了 FixAgent，它结合了多智能体协作与工具使用，以模拟真实开发者的工作流程，并将诊断、打补丁和验证划分为独立阶段。 为了进一步扩展推理能力，近期的系统将检索、规划和工具交互直接嵌入到推理循环中。Chen 等人 [ 26 ] 将检索功能整合到多步骤推理中，使 LLM 在解决问题时能够动态获取并融入外部知识。Yan 等人 [ 39 ] 将反思与工具执行相结合，通过智能体内部的自我批判和智能体间的反馈，在调用工具前后修订计划。最后，Schick 等人 [ 40 ] 证明了工具调用可以被学习并直接嵌入 LLM 的生成过程中，使模型能够通过执行代码、观察结果并根据结果更新计划来进行推理。

paragraphs.en: Building on these reasoning patterns, recent research has developed multi-agent systems that distribute debugging responsibilities across specialized LLM agents. Qin et al. [ 41 ] propose AgentFL, a modular framework for bug localization that employs four distinct agents (Test Code Reviewer, Source Code Reviewer, Software Architect, and Software Test Engineer) to analyze different aspects of the codebase using test and documentation signals. paragraphs.en: We will scale ASAD to repository-level debugging, where agents must coordinate across dozens of files while respecting import dependencies, build constraints, and cross-module data flows. This requires capabilities for traversing call graphs, propagating fixes across coupled components, and validating changes against project-wide test suites. We will also close the validation gap by integrating runtime feedback into agent reasoning loops. Agents will execute proposed patches against dynamically generated tests targeting edge cases absent from benchmark suites, using observed crashes, timeouts, and silent failures to detect overfitting and refine patches. We further plan to connect ASAD to developer ecosystems through static analyzers (e.g., Coverity, SonarQube) for fault pre-filtering, IDE linters for project-specific conventions, and version control systems for assessing patch impact through change histories and reviewer feedback. Finally, we will study human-in-the-loop debugging, measuring how agent explanations of fault hypotheses and repair strategies affect developer trust, intervention timing, and collaborative efficiency.

paragraphs.en: Static multi-agent frameworks deploy fixed teams irrespective of bug complexity, leading to inefficient resource use on simple syntax errors and insufficient capacity for complex, multi-file faults. ASAD mitigates both issues by constructing its agent team after analyzing the fault. In our experiments, a single repair agent successfully resolves 73% of straightforward bugs, while more complex cases dynamically trigger a team of specialized agents. Our evaluation on DebugBench, Defects4J, and CodeFlaws substantiates the effectiveness of this approach. ASAD improves fix accuracy by 12–20% over chain-of-thought prompting and by 4–9% over static multi-agent systems. These gains were achieved with 32% lower average agent usage, as ASAD scales down for simple bugs instead of imposing uniform multi-agent overhead. Together, these results suggest a broader design principle for agentic software engineering: agent configuration should be a function of problem complexity rather than a fixed predefined choice.
